titles.romaji: Tao Tao Ehonkan Sekai Doubutsu Banashi
titles.native: タオタオ絵本館・世界動物ばなし

description:
In a valley in China which has never been visited by humans lives a little panda named Tao Tao. Together with his friends Kiki the monkey, Puhu the squirrel and Poe the hare, they play in the forest all day long.

(Source: Anime News Network)
